caption: The drawing features a central rectangular panel bordered by a broad, patterned frame with repeated lines and geometric designs in shades of red, gold, and brown. In the center, there is an arch-topped black plaque with gold lettering listing the names and birthdates of the children of David and Sarah Clements. Surrounding the central plaque, decorative motifs of stylized floral and leaf elements extend outward, including large symmetric leaves in gold and greenish-yellow hues, with red and gold flowers at the corners and base. Above the arch, two large, angled red-gold flowers face each other, and a similar large flower appears below, flanked by leafy branches. The color palette consists mainly of earth tones such as brown, gold, red, and muted green, with all elements arranged symmetrically around the central text panel. The artist's name, "Albert Levone," is written in the lower right outside the main frame.
title: Birth Record
